tests.text: Sign-up form validates required fields and email format
Password strength rules enforced with inline feedback

Duplicate email shows correct error state
Role selection persists and drives subsequent screens
Profile fields save correctly and reload on relaunch
Skip/back navigation does not lose entered data
TOTP code entry accepts valid code and rejects invalid code
Resend code flow respects cooldown timer
OAuth redirect returns to app correctly
Linked account appears in account list post-connection
Cancel mid-flow returns user to prior screen without crash
Plan comparison renders correct pricing and feature lists
Selecting a plan carries through to payment step
Completion screen confirms setup and routes to dashboard
Dashboard reflects onboarding-selected preferences
Company size and industry fields required and validated
Team invite step optional and skippable
Client-linking step displays correct empty state
Certification/license field optional, not blocking
Multi-user seat selection reflects pricing tier
Admin role assignment step validates at least one admin
